faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about GetGasNG. Can't find your answer? Call or WhatsApp us.

items.question: How fast is delivery in Port Harcourt?
items.answer: Our average delivery time across Port Harcourt is 42 minutes. For most areas in GRA, Rumuola, Woji, and Trans Amadi, we consistently deliver in under an hour. For same-day delivery, orders must be placed before 6 PM.

items.question: Do I need to be home for the delivery?
items.answer: For safety reasons, someone must be present to receive the cylinder and sign off on the delivery. You can also authorise a trusted adult — a housekeeper or family member — to receive on your behalf. Simply note this in your delivery instructions.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept debit/credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), bank transfers, USSD payments, and cash on delivery. For subscription plans, your preferred payment method is saved securely for automated billing.

items.question: Are your cylinders DPR certified and safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. All our LPG cylinders are sourced from DPR-licensed suppliers and undergo regular safety inspections. Our delivery agents are trained in safe LPG handling and will check connections after installation for your peace of mind.

items.question: Can I buy a new cylinder, or just refill?
items.answer: You can do both. Our prices shown are for gas refills (you exchange your empty cylinder). If you need a brand-new cylinder with gas, select "New Cylinder" in the app or call us — pricing varies by size. We'll deliver it fully loaded and ready to use.

items.question: How does the auto-refill subscription work?
items.answer: Choose your cylinder size and refill frequency (weekly, fortnightly, or monthly). We'll automatically schedule your next delivery and send a reminder notification 24 hours before. You can pause, reschedule, or cancel anytime in the app with no penalties.
